patterns.note: A dark, starry background serves as a consistent backdrop, over which distinct, rounded-corner content blocks appear to float, creating a sense of depth.
A clean, modern sans-serif typography is used throughout, featuring large, bold headings for impact and smaller, legible body text for product descriptions and details.
The primary color scheme revolves around a deep purple-blue base, accented with vibrant purples for interactive elements and white text for high contrast and readability.
A fixed, starry background creates a subtle parallax effect as the main page content scrolls over it, enhancing the 'space' or 'world' theme.
Product listing sections are consistently structured with a bold, centered heading, followed by a grid of product cards, and concluded with a prominent 'Shop All' call-to-action button.

technique_notes: The site uses a fixed background image of stars, creating a subtle parallax scrolling effect where the main content layers scroll over the static background, enhancing the 'space' theme.
Content sections are presented within large, rounded-rectangle containers, often with gradient fills or solid colors, providing clear visual separation against the dark page background.
Product listings are displayed in responsive grids of simple cards, each featuring a product image, title, and a clear 'Sold Out' status, with a primary call-to-action button below each section.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) provide strong hierarchy, complemented by clean, legible body text and smaller, uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Predominantly rounded corners are used across all interactive elements, buttons, input fields, and large content containers, creating a soft and approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy spacing is used, particularly in the hero section, while product grids maintain a clear but efficient density with consistent padding around items.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is the pervasive integration of playful, stylized 3D 'Hedgies' characters and objects, which are central to the brand identity and create an immersive, unique 'world' for the merchandise. This, combined with the dark, starry background, elevates it beyond a typical e-commerce store into a branded experience.
